newsitem.title: USA: Netter Digital reports FY96 loss.
newsitem.headline: Netter Digital reports FY96 loss.

text.p: Netter Digital Entertainment Inc Monday reported a net loss of $257,000, or $0.11 a share for the fiscal year ended June 30, 1996, compared to a profit of $97,000 or $0.05 a share for the previous year.
The company said net revenues were $23.7 million compared to $18.9 million reported in 1995. Gross margin increased to $1.17 million, compared to $790,000 in 1995.
The company said its weighted average number of common shares were 2,404,356 and 1,860,000 in 1996 and 1995, respectively.
